job.question: What is the proposal deadline, and how many copies must be submitted, for the City of Madison (Florida) Police Officers' and Firefighters' Retirement System RFP No. 2025-0901 for investment consulting services?
job.expected_facts: Proposals must be received by 2:00 p.m. on September 1, 2025 at the City Clerk's office in Madison, FL (late proposals returned unopened); an original and five (5) copies must be submitted in a sealed envelope/package.
job.acceptance: Accept 2pm September 1, 2025 and original plus five copies/six total. Address, sealing and late-return treatment are optional.

reviews.reason: The document is Hawaii ERS RFP 2022-04 for private equity consultant services, not the City of Madison, Florida RFP 2025-0901. Its deadline and copy requirements apply to that different procurement and do not support the requested facts.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii Request for Proposals Private Equity Consultant Services RFP 2022-04 Issued AUGUST 29, 2022

A master (so marked), 15 hard copies (one copy must be unbound and ready to photocopy), and one (1) electronic copy of the long questionnaire (MS Word or Adobe Acrobat) and one (1) electronic copy of the excel questionnaire response must be received no later than 4:30 p.m. (Hawaii Standard Time) September 30, 2022.
